facts.lesson: In the Workshop, the Notice Board sits on tile (2,7) and blocks movement — a body standing on (2,7) cannot move off it in any direction.

In the Workshop, a body spawning at (2,7) is trapped: the Notice Board occupies that exact tile and blocks all movement (W/A/S/D, diagonals, long holds) and KeyE interaction does nothing. Cannot reach materials or workbench from there.
